title: Content retention activation
description: Content-free result of `medre storage retention activate`: one newly opened operator activation epoch. The activation performs no collection and claims no physical erasure.

epoch.description: The newly assigned epoch number. Repeating the command appends a new epoch each time; numbers are never reused.

activated_at.description: Activation timestamp of the new epoch.

admission_watermark.description: The admission high-water pinned inside the activation transaction; null records an empty store. Pre-activation history is never swept.
